name: Winter Set
about: Five songs after DeepChord presents Echospace, as in the hour-long Winter Set video: Set mode, Transition Mix (each song's outro mixed into the next).

name: 4 to 5 a.m.
about: The four pieces of the hour-long night video (4 a.m. to 5 a.m.), in its order, as DUB-1 1.5 plays them (the video was 1.1.0's); Endless: change pieces by hand, as the video does.

name: The Pieces
about: DUB-1's own eight pieces, as a new FM-1 has them: load it to get the originals back (your pieces are replaced: back up first). Endless, as a new FM-1.
